title: Church Accountability
definition: Church Accountability is the loving responsibility believers have to encourage, correct, restore, and watch over one another under Christ.
summary: The Church helps believers endure through mutual care and correction.
christFocus: Jesus Christ shepherds His people through His Word, His Spirit, and the loving ministry of the body.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Church Accountability teaches that Christ does not redeem people into isolation but into a gathered, accountable, worshiping, serving, and mission-shaped people. The Church belongs to Jesus, is formed by the Gospel, and is strengthened by the Word, prayer, ordinances, fellowship, and Spirit-empowered service.

This doctrine helps believers see the Church as more than a place to attend. It is the household of God, the body of Christ, and a visible witness to the grace, holiness, unity, and truth of the Lord.

The specific emphasis here is the church helps believers endure through mutual care and correction.. A healthy church life displays Christ's care for His people and His mission to the world.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because many people treat church as optional, consumer-driven, or disconnected from discipleship. Church Accountability calls believers back to Christ's design for His people, where worship, truth, love, accountability, service, and mission are held together.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Participate in church life with humility and faithfulness. Let church accountability move you to serve, forgive, gather, pray, give, submit to Scripture, care for others, and help the body of Christ grow in love and maturity.
